test_make_humenv: test the make_humenv function with parametrized num_envs, vectorization_mode, seed, and state_init configurations
run_make_humenv_sync: run make_humenv with sync vectorization mode and FlattenObservation wrapper to create a parallel environment
run_make_humenv_async: run make_humenv with async vectorization mode to create a parallel environment for multiple agents
test_humenv_reset_step: test the humenv environment reset and step loop with sampled actions across multiple environments
test_humenv_state_init: test humenv environment with Default or Fall state initialization and validate observation consistency
